items.source: ValueConversionContext that allows to delegate read/write to an underlying CassandraConverter.

items.source: CassandraCustomConversions.CassandraConverterConfigurationAdapter encapsulates creation of CustomConversions.ConverterConfiguration with Cassandra specifics.
items.translation: CassandraCustomConversions.CassandraConverterConfigurationAdapter 封装了带有 Cassandra 特定细节的 CustomConversions.ConverterConfiguration 的创建。

items.source: Simple singleton to convert Dates to their Cassandra Instant representation for the CQL Timestamp type.
items.translation: 一个简单的单例，用于将 Java 的 Date 转换为 Cassandra CQL Timestamp 类型的 Instant 表示形式。

items.source: Simple singleton to convert LocalTimes to their Long representation.

items.translation: 一个简单的单例，用于将 Long 转换为它们的 LocalTime 表示形式。

items.source: Simple singleton to convert Rows to their Date representation.
